name: wwjd
description: What Would Johannes Do: opinionated UI/UX rules and workflow. Three skills (wwjd:ux for structure, behaviour and copy; wwjd:look for the look; wwjd:motion for motion), a cold critic agent on request, a prompt hook that routes UI work, and an auto-lint hook after UI edits.

creativity.title: Look: plain ↔ expressive
